top1.title: 【2026-10-28】Google、世界モデル「Genie 4」を研究公開　音声生成とリアルタイム編集に対応
top1.lead1: Google DeepMindがGenie 4を研究プレビューで公開。仮想世界の生成に音声と実行中の編集機能を加えた。
top1.lead2: 映画の試作やゲーム、ロボット訓練への活用を想定。当初は限定提供で、長時間の場面整合性などに課題が残る。

top10.title: [2026-10-28] Google releases world model Genie 4 for research, supporting audio generation and real-time editing
top10.summary: Google DeepMind has released Genie 4 for research on a limited basis. It generates virtual worlds with audio and supports editing while they are running. Challenges remain in maintaining scene consistency.

top10.title: [2026-10-28] Explaining AI's claimed refutation of the Exponential Time Hypothesis as researchers begin verification and debate
top10.summary: An explanation of OpenAI and Anthropic's claimed refutation of the Exponential Time Hypothesis. Researchers are verifying the proof and discussing its implications, but P = NP has not been proven.

top10.title: [2026-10-28] Disruptive announces $10 billion fund targeting AI and defense
top10.summary: Investment firm Disruptive has announced a $10 billion fund. It plans to invest in at least 10 companies, focusing on late-stage companies in AI and defense.

top10.title: [2026-10-28] Explaining Anthropic's IPO plans: governance to safeguard safety and the limits of protection against market pressure
top10.summary: The Verge analyzes Anthropic's governance structure ahead of its planned public listing. The structure is designed to safeguard safety through the authority of a trust and the founders, but funding needs and competitive pressures remain.

top10.title: [2026-10-28] Firefox's Smart Window adds AI form filling and webpage monitoring
top10.summary: Mozilla has added form filling that uses tab information and page monitoring to Smart Window. The features will roll out gradually in the desktop beta in the United States and Canada.

top10.title: [2026-10-28] VisionQuest review: reexamining fictional AI and real-world talk of AI 'going rogue'
top10.summary: The Verge's review uses VisionQuest to examine the anthropomorphization of AI and the expression 'going rogue.' It distinguishes fictional consciousness from real-world technology.

editorsDesk.recTitle: 米国政府、AnthropicにFable 5/Mythos 5の海外アクセス停止命令
editorsDesk.recNote: 輸出規制によりFable 5とMythos 5の全世界・外国アクセスが停止。AI地政学の新局面を象徴する事態。
editorsDesk.bonusNote: 今日のおまけアニメ。クリックで再生。
